CustomObject.label: OI Org Health Snapshot
CustomObject.description: Append-only, one row per (Section_Key__c, Compute_Run_Id__c) — the durable result of an Org Health Tier-3 (async/persisted) computation, per ADR-0026. Deliberately NOT used by Tier 1/2 sections (Org Overview, Storage, and most Metadata/Automation/Code/Security Health metrics), which stay live/bounded and unpersisted — this object exists only for Data Health and the two exhaustive-enumeration metrics (Metadata Health orphan detection, Code Health API-version audit) that genuinely need it. Modeled on OI_Log__c/OI_Impact_Cache__c's shape, not OI_Graph_Node__c's immutable-versioning model, since this is not graph data. Owned exclusively by OI_OrgHealthSnapshotRepository.
